body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW24cXHy3TwZ1NKPBwF4xaB3M)_

Before: the review guide listed about 40 problems in the modules: load-time errors, keys bound to commands that do not exist, `provide` forms with the wrong feature name, settings that were assigned several times so only the last one counted, and docs that described the bugs instead of the code. All agenda views were split between `sp-org-agenda` and `sp-vulpea-para`.

After: each problem that still existed is fixed in its module (28 modules plus `init.el`) and in its literate doc under `docs/tangles/`. All custom agenda views, native and the PARA view, are in a new module `sp-agenda-views`. Every touched doc tangles back to exactly its `.el`, and every touched `.el` reads without syntax errors.

How: edited each `.el` and its `.org` together and checked by tangling the docs into a scratch copy and diffing against the modules. `sp-agenda-views.el` is tangled from `docs/tangles/text/sp-org-agenda.org`, which no longer has a file-wide `:tangle`; each top-level heading has a `:header-args:emacs-lisp:` drawer naming its target (explained in `README.org`). `sp-org-ext` requires the new module right after `sp-vulpea-para`.

**Already resolved before this PR (nothing to do):** the `dirvish-define-preview` `setq` in `sp-dired`, the `yadm` TRAMP method in `sp-vcontrol`, the `org-todo-keywords` paren in `sp-org-taskman-extra`, `setq` inside `:custom` in `sp-org-base`, and `sp-tab-inbox-copy` (file removed). The `lem-dashboard` duplicate in `init.el` was still there and is fixed.

**Judgement calls (please check):**
- `sp-agenda-views`: views are added with `add-to-list` so none is lost or replaced. The two clashing keys changed: Daily Agenda is `D` (was `d`, which stays Dashboard) and Weekly Review is `R` (was `w`, which stays Workflow Status).
- `sp-vulpea-para`: adds its capture templates with `add-to-list` instead of replacing the earlier ones, so the `l`/`i` templates are available again.
- `sp-base-code`: `outline-minor-mode-cycle` replaces the global TAB binding, so TAB cycles only on headings.
- `sp-vulpea-base`, `sp-backups`: removed the overridden duplicate settings; effective values are unchanged. Notes dir is still `~/notes/` only.
- `sp-keys`: window `o` is plain `other-window`; the other window keys point at the `lem-*` commands.
- Left alone: the `sp-splash` footer placeholder (needs your text), `sp-org-navigation` (comments only), and `sp-bibprocess` defining one function twice (not in the guide).
- `vc-handled-backends` is removed from `sp-prog-misc`, as requested.

**Docs synced to your hand edits:** `sp-org-base.org`, `sp-org-appearance.org` and `sp-base-libraries.org` had not followed your commits (babel languages, `org-appear`, `org-catch-invisible-edits`), so tangling them would have reverted them. They now match the modules.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

commit.message:
Fix the issues found in the module doc review

Fixes load-time errors, undefined commands, wrong feature names and
duplicated or overwritten settings in 28 modules and in init.el, and
updates the matching literate docs in docs/tangles. The docs for
sp-org-base, sp-org-appearance and sp-base-libraries are also brought in
line with the hand edits in the modules.

commit.message:
Move the agenda views to sp-agenda-views, tangled from sp-org-agenda.org

All custom agenda views, native and the vulpea-para one, now live in
sp-agenda-views.el. It is tangled from the same document as
sp-org-agenda.el, so the document sets :tangle per top-level heading
instead of file-wide. Also drops the vc-handled-backends setting and
brings the sp-org-appearance doc in line with main.
